plan4m.highlight: All-in-one platform connecting studios, trainers, and members in one ecosystem.
plan4m.desc: Membership tracking, session scheduling, payments, and reporting — separate flows for studio owners, personal trainers, and members. Smart renewal reminders and revenue reports in one app.

easyfinai.highlight: Voice-powered expense logging — AI-driven income, expense, and budget management.
easyfinai.desc: Say "600 TL groceries" and it's logged automatically. Smart categories, chart reports, and a real-time dashboard. Secure, encrypted finance tracking with no bank connection required.

futbo.highlight: Full football club operations — from training and scouting to finance and health.
futbo.desc: Training and match planning, player scouting, athletic performance analysis, finance, and health management. AI-powered analytics and player CV system with tailored solutions for every department.

vgen.highlight: From energy trading to plant management — real-time market and facility operations in one panel.
vgen.desc: Day-ahead market transactions, plant and consumption facility planning, hourly production-consumption charts, and KGÜP revisions. Strategic decisions on mobile with position tracking and market reports.

cartech.highlight: Professional AI backgrounds for car photos — in seconds.
cartech.desc: Automatically removes the background and generates realistic visuals with showroom, nature, or city environments. Makes sales listings and social media posts more compelling.
